summary: Keep the go directive at the repo .go-version floor and do not pin a toolchain newer than that floor.
reason: toolchain go1.27.2 is still affected by GO-2026-6809 (fixed in go1.26.10 and go1.27.3) and makes Go 1.26.10 CI download that toolchain. A toolchain line equal to the go directive is redundant: go mod tidy deletes it and go build refuses to run until it is gone. A reprint must not restore the affected 1.27.0–1.27.2 toolchain.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go mod tidy -diff succeed on Go 1.26.10.
